scoring.performance: Minimize ensemble total_wall_s; report aggregate_ns_per_day and speedup relative to sequential baseline at identical fixed work.
scoring.correctness: Brief predicts bit-identical per-replica energy series under identical seeds, GPU model, software and deterministic forces. Otherwise compare changes against measured sequential run-to-run variation.
scoring.reason: No published numerical acceptance tolerance or quantitative variation supplied. Brief predictions are hypotheses, not independently published acceptance criteria.
scoring.published_reference_scoring: Reference only; null tolerance means no anchor acceptance test.

repeatability.seed_usage: Same replica seed sets initial velocities and integrator random stream.
